claims.claim: Four named subscribers filed the September 18 complaint against the four named companies.
Plaintiffs allege coordination slowed product improvement and reduced subscription value; the filing itself decides none of the alleged conduct, unlawfulness, or remedy.
claims.boundary: Allegation, not proven conduct, harm or liability.

claims.claim: Complaint does not seek to prohibit independent safety measures or independent slowing.
claims.boundary: Pleading scope, not a ruling about lawful conduct.

claims.claim: Class certification, damages and injunctive relief are requested.
claims.boundary: Requested in the filing; the filing does not approve class certification or grant relief.

claims.claim: Plaintiffs invoke antitrust law in arguing that an alleged agreement restrained competition.
claims.boundary: Explanation of the pleaded legal theory, not legal advice or a court conclusion.

claims.claim: The complaint identifies a September 12 public call by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to slow AI capability improvements so safety work could keep up.
claims.boundary: Plaintiffs’ pleaded account of the preceding sequence, not proof of a cross-company agreement or an implemented policy.
